items.title: Sonny Rollins — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he’d have all these guys–Dexter Gordon, and uh, Fats Navarro, and Wardell Gray and, you know uh, all these people of the period, and the real guys–giants–who were playing this music. So, I got a chance, he would get me on these gigs. I got a chance to play with all these guys.

ctx.x: Well, Babs was a character, and people have different opinions about him, you know, very negative ones, et cetera, et cetera. Uh, most people have negative opinions about Babs, as a matter of fact. But uh...he gave me an opportunity, because he was a– Babs was a guy that just wanted to hear young guys play. Well, I was a young guy and had... “Wow, this guy can play,” and he’d, you know. And I got a chance to work with a lot of great people. Babs would get a job, and he was good at getting these gigs, and he’d…
How do you think he heard about you, or knew about you?
